sentence: This project studies how the bacterium that causes anthrax survives inside immune cells and how immune cells stop it from growing.
This project builds models that predict how the human face grows in three dimensions, using machine learning.
This project studies how the eyes of animals with strabismus turn toward what they see, and tests a treatment for amblyopia in non-human primates.
This project studies how aging weakens memory T cells, using tonsil organoids engineered with CRISPR.
This project provides tools and services for sorting and imaging normal and tumor cells, using flow cytometry, mass cytometry and optical imaging.
This project builds a tool that predicts the risk of colorectal cancer across different genetic ancestry groups, using single-cell data.
This project improves the website, online ordering system and data management of a center that shares rat models with researchers.
This project builds a data center and web portal to store and analyze large sets of data on human pain from tissue and painful neuromas.
This project studies whether digital phenotyping and epigenetics can improve outcomes in acute hypoxemic respiratory failure.
This project supports brain tumor research in epidemiology, molecular studies, immunotherapy and clinical trials.
This project gives statistical and data support to head and neck cancer research projects, from study design to data analysis.
This project supports cancer research by collecting and analyzing genomic and gene expression data with sequencing and computing services.
This project builds a cancer vaccine that targets antigens arising from patient-specific mutations.
This project studies ways to diagnose and treat brain cancer, especially how to overcome resistance to treatments such as immunotherapy.
This project builds drugs that destroy or switch off disease-causing proteins involved in oncology.
This project tests a wireless metamaterial cage that measures forces on the spine during spinal fusion in animals.
This project provides access to quantitative proteomics tools for researchers studying human diseases including cancer.
This project tests whether home food delivery and video-based motivational counseling help rural smokers quit smoking.
This project builds statistical methods and software for analyzing microbiome data so discoveries about human health are more reliable.
This project studies how a kinase helps a signaling cascade that guides heart development, using induced pluripotent stem cells.
